body:
Well, I just combat logged on Justice I, When I was making a Skybridge.

Im really Sorry but on that minute I was really angry because sometimes I die when I´m making a bridge.
Thanks for Reading, Im Really Sorry!

title: Appealing for a Combat Log [TempBan]

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

Because this is a valid punishment i'm sorry that i have to deny this appeal.

Your Temp-ban only goes for an hour so don't worry.
Just a heads up. Do it again and the time on these temp bans go higher.

Regards,
SaladMan, Senior Mod.
